Brand concept and production guide

MORIELA

Considered, down to the last detail.

The starting point

Considered, down to the last detail.

For a tailoring brand, the experience starts before a fitting and continues after the garment is collected. MORIELA’s direction connects the care in the clothes to the language, packaging and ordering details around them.

The work covered

  • Audience and positioning
  • Visual identity direction
  • Packaging and digital guidance
  • Voice and customer experience

The decisions

A reason for
the choices.

Espresso, ivory and warm beige create a tactile foundation, with gold and seasonal accents used sparingly. The proposed serif wordmark aims to carry from a website header to a small garment label. The guide treats final artwork and production proofs as the next stage.

The words

Quality, tailored to you.

A direct promise with room for personality. Supporting copy favours fit, finish and clear order details over distant luxury language.
